Subject: Solstice — intro + exec sponsor demo (two proposed windows)

Hi Alex / Natalie —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a 45-minute exec-level walkthrough focused on the sponsor use cases (CTO / VP presence ideal). To make scheduling simple, can you confirm which of these windows works for your execs? We can tighten to 30 if needed.

Option A: Tue 16 Mar, 11:00–11:45 PT (14:00–14:45 ET)
Option B: Tue 16 Mar, 12:00–12:45 PT (15:00–15:45 ET)

Attached: high-level agenda (PDF) and a mutual action plan (MAP) draft.

Ask: if the CTO can only do the later slot but VP can join briefly, we can open a short Q&A window at the end. Please let me know preferred slot and whether procurement should be looped in for commercial topics — I can include them on the invite.

Best,
Kimberly Park

kimberly_park@redwood.com
(415) 555-0147

Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Solstice — intro + exec sponsor demo (two proposed windows)

Thanks Kimberly —

Both options look close. Quick note on exec availability: our CTO (Ethan R.) is tight that day and prefers the later window (Option B) but can join 30 minutes if needed. Our VP of Products (Amira S.) can do Option A but only for the first 20–25 minutes before a standing conflict.

If there's a way to start with the 25-minute core demo that hits the sponsor blockers and then keep a 20-minute deep dive for engineering/procurement, we can make both execs useful. Procurement (procurement@solsticeai.com) may sit in for pricing.

Could you propose a plan that accommodates a staggered exec presence? Also, send the final condensed agenda when you have it.

— Alex

Head of Integrations, Solstice AI
alex.monroe@solsticeai.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Solstice — intro + exec sponsor demo (two proposed windows)

Appreciate the detail, Alex — this is helpful. Internal plan that I propose:

- Core 25-min sponsor demo (flows & ROI highlights) — aimed at CTO/VP overlap.
- 20-min technical deep dive + procurement Q&A immediately after (engineering + procurement).
- Dry-run with our engineers on Mon 15 Mar at 11:00 PT to rehearse handoff and timing.

Ben — can you prepare a 25-minute condensed deck that covers 1) top 3 sponsor value props, 2) one live example, 3) next steps + MAP? Marissa — please pencil the dry-run on 15 Mar 11:00 PT and book the meeting room/virtual link. Vivek — FYI given this is a top-of-funnel exec slot.

Alex/Natalie — if that plan works, I’ll lock Option A (11:00 PT) as the core and mark Option B as an alternate in case the CTO needs the later start. Final agenda and calendar invite will follow.

Thanks,
Kimberly

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:30:00 -0700

On it — I’ll strip the deck down to a 7-slide, 25-minute flow. Will include:
- Sponsor value section (2 slides)
- Live demo snapshot (1 slide + 3-min live)
- Deployment/ops + next steps/MAP (2 slides)

I’m adding placeholder calendar invites for both windows in PT and ET (ICS stubs) so the client can accept the preferred one. Will also include a short 1-page FAQ for procurement.

Ben

Thanks team — the staggered approach makes sense.

Confirmed: CTO (Ethan R.) can do Tue 16 Mar 14:00–14:45 ET (Option A in your note) and will stay for the 25-minute core. VP (Amira S.) can only join at ~15:00 ET for the wrap/next steps but will try to be present earlier if a conflict clears. Procurement has been copied.

Request: can you condense the agenda to 30–35 minutes total for execs (25-min core + 10-min highlights) so Amira still gets the high-level wrap? Also include a short compliance slide (data residency & encryption) for procurement to review.

If you can send the updated agenda and the final calendar invite, we’ll accept.

— Natalie
